reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the established role of grain boundary cohesion in tungsten (P16, P23) with the specific segregation of Ti and Zr (P17) and applies it to the previously unstudied equimolar WTaTiVZr alloy, proposing a testable mechanism for its plastic strain and toughness that none of the passages directly states.
